loc_451.loc_76: Correction for Schaumann and Alastrué de Asenjo, Weakening AMOC reduces ocean carbon uptake and increases the social cost of carbon

loc_320.loc_124: Correction for "Weakening AMOC reduces ocean carbon uptake and increases the social cost of carbon," by Felix Schaumann and Eduardo Alastrué de Asenjo, which published February 24, 2025; 10.1073/pnas.2419543122 (Proc. Natl. Acad. Sci. U.S.A. 122 , e2419543122).

loc_320.loc_145: The authors note that there was a typographical error in the "Economic damage estimation" subsection of the "Impacts of the AMOC Carbon Feedback" section in the article's . Methods and slairetaM﻿

loc_320.loc_173: The authors explain that on page 8, right column, 4th full paragraph, line 5, "A φ value of 1 means there is no persistence; a φ value of 1 means there is full persistence" should instead appear as "A φ value of 1 means there is no persistence; a φ value of 0 means there is full persistence."

loc_320.loc_187: The authors are correcting the text to ensure that there is clarity in the understanding and interpretability of the applied method.

loc_165.loc_194: The online version has been corrected.
